chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Ibrahim ibn 'Abd al-Hamid, from 'Umar ibn Yazid or someone else, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The mu'tamir performs tawaf, does sa'y, and shaves. He said: and after shaving, he must necessarily perform another tawaf.

key_terms.الْحَلْقِ: the act of shaving after the rites
key_terms.طَوَافٍ آخَرَ: an additional tawaf required after the earlier rites
key_terms.يَحْلِقُ: shaves the head as part of the rite
key_terms.يَسْعَى: performs sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah

ai.seo_question: Is Tawaf al-Nisa' obligatory in al-'Umrah al-Mabtulah after shaving?
ai.summary: This hadith states the rites of the mu'tamir in 'umrah and establishes that an additional tawaf is required after halq. In the chapter context, this indicates the obligation of Tawaf al-Nisa' in al-'Umrah al-Mabtulah.
